name: hephaestus
description: A small workshop of Claude Code tools to keep your craft sharp.

plugins.name: crucible
plugins.description: Doc-discipline (cms), decision stress-testing (grill-me), a structured development workflow (develop), a safe branch lifecycle (start-branch / finish-branch), eval-first development (freeze a baseline, gate on match-or-beat-or-revert), and flag-gate (default-OFF rollout with instant revert).

plugins.name: sqlite-readonly
plugins.description: Zero-config read-only SQLite MCP server — safely query any local .db (3-layer read-only enforcement, schema introspection, natural-language→SQL).

plugins.name: mcp-starter
plugins.description: A minimal, working template for packaging a Python MCP server as a Claude Code plugin — userConfig injection, inline mcpServers, uv-isolated server, first-run hook, /setup wizard.

plugins.name: second-brain
plugins.description: Obsidian inbox processor — proposes tags, links, filing, and action items for your notes, but never commits without your per-item approval. Suggest-then-confirm.

plugins.name: deck-builder
plugins.description: Build polished .pptx decks from source material — code-backed (named layout methods, never hand-rolled geometry), mandatory outline-approval gate, research-backed design rules.
